envelope: [A5 5A][MODULE u8][LENGTH u16 BE][PAYLOAD][CRC-8]; CRC-8/SMBus over MODULE_ID ++ BOTH LENGTH BYTES ++ PAYLOAD (start marker excluded)
layout_0x03: [KIND 0x01][vector_id u16][n_gaps u16][3 x i32 BE per gap]  (D4: NO decision bits); payload = 5 + 12*n_gaps
layout_0x05: [KIND 0x01][vector_id u16][n_spikes u16][ch u8 x n_spikes][3 x i32 BE per gap]; payload = 5 + n + 12*(n-1)
layout_0x06: B1.0 verbatim: [KIND 0x01][seq u16][tu i32][n_marks u16][(end_tick i32, ch u8) x n]; payload = 9 + 5*n  — CANNED input, not an FE capture (vector ticks are absolute, not first-rise-normalized)
